title: Termwise restriction preserves coherent formal objects
statement: Let X be Noetherian and I a quasi-coherent ideal, with Coh(X,I) and its object predicate as in [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. For every open U and every F in Coh(X,I), the actual inverse system F.obj composed with the module restriction functor of [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits] satisfies IsCoherentFormalModule for I.comap U.ι. The induced full-subcategory lift is the actual termwise restriction functor, not a chosen witness.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 087X (30.23.2), part (2) and the final sentence of the proof; verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/087X on 2026-10-13

proof.text: For each level, extract quasi-coherence from its coherence using the locally Noetherian coherence criterion. Restrict coherence using the restriction half of coherent_module_local_on_open_cover, instantiated with the singleton cover by the whole scheme.
Restriction preserves zero objects by its left adjunction. Apply idealPowerProduct_restrict_isZero_iff at level n and exponent n+1 to the restriction of the original annihilation proof.

Reuse the proved private restrictionQuotientIso and restrictionQuotientIso_π of TorsionControlledFormalRestriction. They construct the canonical restricted ideal-power quotient comparison and its projection equation from image equality and cokernel comparisons. Compose that isomorphism with the restriction of the given transition isomorphism, reassociate, rewrite by the projection equation and functor.map_comp, then apply the original transition equation. No local image or quotient comparison is re-proved.

proof_origin.place: G3 stage 3 second reading: Stacks Lemma 087X (2). Reuse coherence locality, ideal-power annihilation restriction, and the already constructed quotient comparison with projection equation from TorsionControlledFormalRestriction. All local duplicate comparison helpers removed; unchanged formal-module object predicate assembled directly, with no new sorry.

theorem coherentFormalModules_restriction_objects {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData) (U : X.Opens)
    (F : CoherentFormalModule X I) :
    IsCoherentFormalModule (I.comap U.ι)
      (F.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι)
